title: Defensive two-point returns (experimental)
summary: Enable defensive try returns, split scoring history, original-team kickoff, try safeties and CPU return selection. Includes a temporary diagnostic team tally; the retail box-score category remains unimplemented.

backend.command: python3 -c "import importlib, sys; from pathlib import Path; module = importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1][:-3].replace('/', '.')); payload, receipt = module.apply(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()); Path(sys.argv[3]).open('xb').write(payload); print(receipt)" mod_editor/core/nfl2k5_defensive_try.py <source.xbe> <new-copy.xbe>

gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. All presets leave this off. Manual witness-disc selection only after protected integration, with the missing box-score category disclosed.

input_constraints: User-owned USA NFL 2K5 executable in a disposable disc image; pinned instructions and recognized section geometry.
Allocate the complete owner union before growth. Changing owners requires rebuilding from base.
Exhibition witness build only. No saved defensive-conversion player, season or franchise category is implemented.
portme: Implement and prove the missing retail box-score row and persistent category before calling the full stat requirement complete.
Complete every Noah witness in ASTRA_DEFENSIVE_TRY_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute source and recipes, never a generated retail executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Static and bounded Unicorn proofs only. Actual loader, score bug, box score, commentary, CPU motion, penalties and period/OT behavior remain unwitnessed. The diagnostic tally is limited to retained drive history.

fields.name: defensive_try
fields.allowed: false in all presets; explicit true only for a witness disc

selectors.notes: Implies grown executable space. Both retail and modern kick spots are supported. Does not imply relocated kickoff.
